testcase.name: Scenario: Switch navigation panes without changing the selected file: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:74:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch navigation panes without changing the selected file ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And its project navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders ✔ And a saved part is selected with its file name and preview displayed ✔ And `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is selected with its name and preview ✔ When the user switches to the system folder navigation pane ✔ Then common system locations are displayed in the navigation pane ✔ And the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed ✔ When the user switches back to the project navigation pane ✔ Then libraries and recent folders are displayed again ✔ And the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed
